scripts.build: bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json && rsync -a --include='*/' --include='*.d.ts' --exclude='*' src/ dist/src/
scripts.generate:cfg-weapons: node scripts/generate-cfg-tree.mjs data/cfgWeapons.json src/cfg/cfg-weapons.ts cfgWeapons weapons
scripts.generate:cfg-weapons-equipment: node scripts/generate-cfg-tree.mjs data/cfgWeaponsEquipment.json src/cfg/cfg-weapons-equipment.ts cfgWeaponsEquipment weaponsEquipment
scripts.generate:cfg-weapons-items: node scripts/generate-cfg-tree.mjs data/cfgWeaponsItems.json src/cfg/cfg-weapons-items.ts cfgWeaponsItems weaponsItems
scripts.generate:cfg-magazines: node scripts/generate-cfg-tree.mjs data/cfgMagazines.json src/cfg/cfg-magazines.ts cfgMagazines magazines
scripts.generate:cfg: bun run generate:cfg-weapons && bun run generate:cfg-weapons-equipment && bun run generate:cfg-weapons-items && bun run generate:cfg-magazines
